exposure: Planned mode of delivery after previous cesarean section
outcome: Overnight readmission to hospital within 42 days of birth
cohort: Women delivering a term singleton with one or more previous cesarean sections
finding: Planned VBAC compared to ERCS is associated with an increased risk of serious birth-related maternal and perinatal complications but an increased likelihood of breastfeeding, while the effect on other maternal outcomes differs according to prior vaginal deliveries and number of prior cesarean sections.
